8.4.original_text: Certificado de Capacidad de Almacenamiento y Acondicionamiento, CCAA... en el que consta el cumplimiento de las condiciones sanitarias para el almacenamiento y/o acondicionamiento, control de calidad...
8.4.english_translation: Certificate of Storage and Conditioning Capacity (CCAA)... which states compliance with sanitary conditions for storage and/or conditioning, quality control...
8.4.semantic_note: The text addresses internal facility quality control, not external supplier management.

8.5.1.rationale_en: The text mandates compliance and quality assurance for storage facilities but does not outline a general process or requirement for continuous improvement (general improvement).
8.5.1.rationale_zh: 文本要求儲存設施符合規範和品質保證，但沒有概述持續改進（一般改善）的通用流程或要求。
8.5.1.original_text: Certificado de Capacidad de Almacenamiento y Acondicionamiento, CCAA. Es el acto administrativo que expide... en el que consta el cumplimiento de las condiciones sanitarias para el almacenamiento y/o acondicionamiento...
8.5.1.english_translation: Certificate of Storage and Conditioning Capacity (CCAA). It is the administrative act issued... which states compliance with sanitary conditions for storage and/or conditioning...
8.5.1.semantic_note: Focus is on maintaining current state quality, not driving improvement.

unique_requirements.title_en: Mandatory Certification for Reconditioned Device Importation
unique_requirements.title_zh: 翻新设备进口的强制性认证要求
unique_requirements.requirement_en: The importation of reconditioned (repotenciados) Class I, IIa, IIb, and III biomedical devices is permitted only if the device meets all required specifications AND is accompanied by a certification of good functioning issued by the legal manufacturer or its representative in Colombia.
unique_requirements.requirement_zh: 只有当翻新（repotenciados）I、IIa、IIb和III类生物医学设备符合所有要求，并且附有由合法制造商或其在哥伦比亚的代表出具的良好运行认证时，才允许进口。
unique_requirements.audit_question_en: For reconditioned devices imported into Colombia, how do you ensure that the required 'certification of good functioning' is obtained from either the legal manufacturer or their local representative?
unique_requirements.audit_question_zh: 对于进口到哥伦比亚的翻新设备，您如何确保获得了合法制造商或其当地代表出具的“良好运行认证”？
expected_evidence: Certificate of Good Functioning (Certificación de buen funcionamiento)
unique_requirements.rationale_en: ISO 13485 focuses on the QMS for manufacturing and design. This requirement is specific to national trade regulations governing the import and certification process of *reconditioned* devices, which is a country-specific regulatory hurdle.
unique_requirements.rationale_zh: ISO 13485侧重于制造和设计的QMS。此要求是针对翻新设备的进口和认证过程的特定国家贸易法规，属于国家特定的监管障碍。
unique_requirements.original_text: Se permitirá el ingreso al país de equipos biomédicos repotenciados clase I, IIa, IIb y III siempre y cuando cumplan con los requisitos del equipo biomédico y se acompañen de la certificación de buen funcionamiento emitida por el fabricante legal o su representante en el país
unique_requirements.english_translation: The entry into the country of reconditioned biomedical equipment Class I, IIa, IIb and III will be permitted provided that they comply with the requirements of the biomedical equipment and are accompanied by the certification of good functioning issued by the legal manufacturer or its representative in the country.
unique_requirements.semantic_note: Manufacturers must establish a robust process to manage third-party certifications (reconditioning/used device status) and ensure local representation is utilized for official documentation required by INVIMA.

unique_requirements.title_en: Mandatory Documentation for Used Device Parity
unique_requirements.title_zh: 用于二手设备的强制性文件要求一致性
unique_requirements.requirement_en: Reconditioned device imports must also include the same documentation that is required for used medical devices.
unique_requirements.requirement_zh: 翻新设备进口还必须附带与二手医疗设备相同的所需文件。
unique_requirements.audit_question_en: When importing reconditioned devices, how do you ensure that all documentation required for 'used medical devices' is included and maintained alongside the good functioning certification?
unique_requirements.audit_question_zh: 在进口翻新设备时，您如何确保除了良好运行认证外，还包含了所有“二手医疗设备”所需的文档并进行了维护？
expected_evidence: Checklist mapping required documentation for used devices
unique_requirements.rationale_en: ISO 13485 does not specify that reconditioned or imported used goods must adhere to the exact same documentation standards as a specific national category of 'used medical devices.' This is a country-specific regulatory linkage.
unique_requirements.rationale_zh: ISO 13485并未规定翻新或进口的二手货物必须遵守特定国家“二手医疗设备”类别的确切文件标准。这是一个国家特定的监管关联。
unique_requirements.original_text: y anexando la misma documentación exigida para los equipos biomédicos usados.
unique_requirements.english_translation: and annexing the same documentation required for used biomedical equipment.
unique_requirements.semantic_note: This requires manufacturers/importers to maintain a specific, separate set of records and compliance documents tailored to the 'used' category as defined by Colombian law.
